title: Sinomenine prevents monocrotaline-induced pulmonary arterial hypertension by inhibiting osteopontin-mediated PASMC phenotypic switching.
authors: Zeng, Zhenhua; Chen, Ziyi; Liu, Jianxin; Xu, Wen; Qin, Yao; Lin, Xinyi; Wu, Weihua; Zhou, Hua; Huang, Xiaoyang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究青藤碱通过结合NF-kappaB抑制骨桥蛋白介导的肺动脉平滑肌细胞表型转换来防治肺动脉高压，虽涉及转录因子NF-kappaB与DNA结合调控，但核心是疾病病理与药物机制，非TF-DNA互作建模研究，方法仅含分子对接且无AI/物理模拟深度。
abstract: Pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH) is a life-threatening disease driven by progressive pulmonary vascular remodeling, and aberrant phenotypic transition of pulmonary arterial smooth muscle cells (PASMCs) serves as the core pathological driver of disease deterioration. Sinomenine (SIN), a structurally defined isoquinoline alkaloid isolated from Sinomenium acutum (Thunb.) Rehder & E.H.Wilson, exhibits anti-inflammatory, vascular-protective, and anti-remodeling activities. Nevertheless, the exact molecular mechanism by which SIN regulates PASMC dysfunction to prevent PAH remains unclear. In vivo, SIN administration significantly attenuated MCT-induced PAH, right ventricular hypertrophy and pulmonary vascular remodeling in rats. In vitro, SIN effectively suppressed platelet-derived growth factor-BB (PDGF-BB)-triggered proliferation, migration and phenotypic switching of PASMCs. RNA-sequencing coupled with KEGG enrichment analysis further identified the ECM-receptor interaction pathway as the key signaling cascade dysregulated by MCT, with osteopontin (OPN) validated as the central functional target of SIN. OPN overexpression recapitulated the pro-remodeling effects of PDGF-BB in PASMCs, and such abnormal phenotypes were prevented by SIN. Molecular docking and cellular thermal shift assay demonstrated that SIN binds to NF-kappaB, a transcription factor of OPN, and suppresses PDGF-BB-induced NF-kappaB activation. This study uncovers a novel mechanism of SIN against PAH and highlights OPN as a critical mediator of its protective effects.
abstract_zh: 肺动脉高压（pulmonary arterial hypertension, PAH）是一种由进行性肺血管重塑驱动的危及生命的疾病，而肺动脉平滑肌细胞（pulmonary arterial smooth muscle cells, PASMCs）的异常表型转化是疾病恶化的核心病理驱动因素。青藤碱（Sinomenine, SIN），一种从青风藤（Sinomenium acutum (Thunb.) Rehder & E.H.Wilson）中分离的结构明确的异喹啉生物碱，具有抗炎、血管保护和抗重塑活性。然而，SIN调节PASMC功能障碍以预防PAH的确切分子机制仍不清楚。在体内，SIN给药显著减轻了大鼠中MCT诱导的PAH、右心室肥大和肺血管重塑。在体外，SIN有效抑制了血小板衍生生长因子-BB（platelet-derived growth factor-BB, PDGF-BB）触发的PASMCs增殖、迁移和表型转换。RNA测序结合KEGG富集分析进一步将ECM-受体相互作用通路确定为MCT失调的关键信号级联，其中骨桥蛋白（osteopontin, OPN）被验证为SIN的核心功能靶点。OPN过表达在PASMCs中重现了PDGF-BB的前重塑效应，而这些异常表型被SIN所阻止。分子对接和细胞热位移实验表明，SIN与NF-kappaB（OPN的转录因子）结合，并抑制PDGF-BB诱导的NF-kappaB激活。本研究揭示了SIN对抗PAH的新机制，并强调OPN是其保护效应的关键介质。
